2609.01909.title: The Ceiling Is in the Channel: Auditing Learner Gaps and Measurement Frontiers in Clinical Prediction
2609.01909.paper_summary: Clinical prediction can saturate for two different reasons: a fitted learner may fail to extract available information, or the recorded variables may impose a population frontier. We separate these quantities through the \emph{learner gap} and the \emph{measurement-channel ceiling}. Optimal balanced accuracy is characterized by total-variation separation, yielding architecture invariance, a sharp partial-identification result under replacement contamination, a cross-fitted ceiling estimator, and exact conditions for multimodal decision improvement. We add two finite-sample diagnostics, namely a label-permutation optimism floor and an underfit curve, and validate the audit on three real cohorts: UCI readmission ($n=99{,}343$), BRFSS diabetes ($n=253{,}680$), and NHANES HbA1c ($n=10{,}219$). Well-tuned gradient boosting nearly reaches the estimated frontier in UCI and BRFSS, whereas deliberately or practically deficient learners retain large gaps. NHANES yields a null difference between questionnaire and measured marginal frontiers but a significant joint complementarity gain, refining the simplistic claim that an objective modality must dominate. Across all cohorts, modest AUROC gains coexist with substantially larger Bayes decision-flip rates, and several architectures estimate similar frontiers while their achieved balanced accuracy differs sharply. A PRISMA-guided synthesis of 104 clinical tasks then shows that the same channel-level regularities recur across more than 18 disease categories: a broad but non-universal structured-clinical region, diminishing same-channel gains across model families, and higher performance when measurement channels change. The framework converts saturation from an empirical observation into an auditable decision: improve the learner when headroom remains; improve measurement when it does not.
2609.01909.paper_summary_zh: 臨床預測可能因兩個不同的原因而飽和：擬合的學習者可能無法提取可用的信息，或者記錄的變量可能施加了人口邊界。我們通過\emph{學習者差距}和\emph{測量通道上限}來區分這些量。最佳平衡準確性以總變異分離為特徵，產生架構不變性、在替代污染下的尖銳部分識別結果、一個交叉擬合的上限估計量，以及多模態決策改進的精確條件。我們添加了兩個有限樣本診斷，即標籤置換樂觀基線和欠擬合曲線，並在三個真實隊列上驗證審計：UCI 再入院（$n=99{,}343$）、BRFSS 糖尿病（$n=253{,}680$）和 NHANES HbA1c（$n=10{,}219$）。調整良好的梯度提升幾乎達到 UCI 和 BRFSS 中的估計邊界，而故意或實際不足的學習者則保留了較大的差距。NHANES 在問卷和測量邊際邊界之間產生了零差異，但卻有顯著的聯合互補增益，精煉了簡化的主張，即客觀模態必須佔主導地位。在所有隊列中，適度的 AUROC 增益與大幅更高的貝葉斯決策翻轉率共存，並且幾個架構估計類似的邊界，而它們實現的平衡準確性卻有明顯差異。然後，根據 PRISMA 指導的 104 個臨床任務的綜合顯示，相同的通道級規律在超過 18 種疾病類別中重複出現：一個廣泛但非普遍的結構化臨床區域、跨模型家族的同通道增益減少，以及當測量通道改變時的更高性能。該框架將飽和從一種實證觀察轉變為可審計的決策：當有空間時改善學習者；當沒有空間時改善測量。
